title_original: The best and worst Bond films: ranked by critics and box office

blocks.text: The announcement of a new James Bond actor leads, inevitably, to ranking the previous Bonds and Bond films.

Robert Pattinson will be the latest actor stepping into cinema’s second-longest running franchise. There have been 27 films since 1962, from the early Sean Connery years to the bombastic action-and-gadget flicks of the 90s, to the more stripped-back “reboot” of Casino Royale.

As such, there’s a decent amount of variation in both quality and box office takings, though all films follow the same basic character and formula – suave spy in a suit, beautiful women, fight scenes and action.
Here you can see how each film ranks on film critics’ reviews, aggregated by Rotten Tomatoes into a single score, and on inflation-adjusted international box office takings.

blocks.alt: A hand-drawn scatterplot showing Bond films sorted by critic score on the x axis and box office takings on the y axis. Skyfall and Goldfinger stand out for being both monetarily successful and critically acclaimed

This article was amended on 20 November 2026. After errors were found in the box office figures listed in Box Office Mojo for some of the older films, the chart was updated using figures from another source. Thunderball, Goldfinger and a few other films now place higher on inflation-adjusted box-office takings.
